A.regional_bus.running_time.description: Geographic minimum running time and dwell where published segment times are unusable; longer usable median published intervals take precedence. Mapped-path feasibility is checked by the native run preparation. Published segment medians exceeding four times the distance-derived interval are flagged and replaced by geographic derivation; source clocks remain unchanged.
A.regional_bus.running_time.sweep_basis: Provisional broad service sensitivity, not calibrated ridership or corridor precision.

A.regional_bus.max_published_segment_s.description: Reject implausibly long single-stop clock differences; negative/zero clock differences are derived from other trips or geometry.
A.regional_bus.max_published_segment_s.sweep_basis: Provisional broad service sensitivity, not calibrated ridership or corridor precision.

A.regional_bus.allocation_day_label.description: Exact weekday label in acquired MBMT municipal route-bus allocation cells. Sum route cells; do not substitute the inconsistent printed subtotal.

A.regional_bus.terminal_layover_s.description: Terminal allowance in the pooled MBMT fleet-hours frequency derivation; not observed vehicle circulation.
A.regional_bus.terminal_layover_s.sweep_basis: Provisional broad service sensitivity, not calibrated ridership or corridor precision.

A.regional_bus.service_window_s.description: Provisional MBMT departure window. NMMT retains acquired departure clocks.
A.regional_bus.service_window_s.sweep_basis: Provisional broad service sensitivity, not calibrated ridership or corridor precision.

A.regional_bus.agency_urls.description: Operator publication attribution in the generated GTFS agency table.

A.regional_bus.timezone.description: Local clock basis for published departures.
